claude_proposed_widenings.name: convert_save_failure_to_success
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Resist Enchantment allows the bearer to retroactively convert a just-failed saving throw into a success. No existing atom models this. It is distinct from modify_roll_advantage (which gives advantage on future rolls) and from any existing post-roll modifier. The effect fires after the die roll is resolved but before the failed-save consequences apply.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveMechanics.resource (charge_pool)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Cast Spell and Reflect Enchantment properties share a single 10-charge pool. The current surface has no way to declare a shared charge pool across composite components. Each ActivationResource-bearing component must redundantly declare the same pool, which misrepresents the shared depletion constraint. PassiveMechanics also cannot declare a charge pool, forcing charge-cast grants into ActivatedAbilityMechanics even when the activation cost is just 'spend the action to cast'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This staff has 10 charges. [Cast Spell] expend 1 charge... [Reflect Enchantment] expend 1 charge from the staff.
